title: Receive files

list.description: Create a link anyone can use to send you files, no account needed.
list.emptyDescription: Create a request and share the link: the files you receive show up among your transfers.
list.noResultsHint: Try other filters or another search.

form.createDescription: Whoever opens the link can upload files without signing in. Files arrive as received transfers.
form.title: Title
form.messageHint: Shown on the upload page. Explain what you want to receive.
form.expiryHint: Also applies to the files received, counted from the moment of the upload. The new expiry counts from today.
form.passwordHint: Whoever opens the link must enter it. At least {{min}} characters.
form.maxSizeHint: Leave empty for no limit. It also counts against your storage.

errors.titleLength: A title is required, at most {{max}} characters.
errors.maxSize: Enter a size greater than zero.
errors.maxSubmissions: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.

created.title: Request created
created.description: Share this link: anyone who opens it can send you files.
created.noLink: The public address is not configured yet: the link is not available.

revokeDescription: The link stops accepting files right away. Files already received stay among your transfers.
deleteDescription: The request is deleted and the link stops working. Files already received stay among your transfers.

detail.inactiveLink: The link no longer accepts files.
detail.noTransfers: Nobody has sent files with this link yet.
